meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 它会先问你想做什么，然后指导你添加聊天渠道、修改触发方式、对接外部服务或调整配置，改完告诉你怎么重启验证。
howto.when: 当你想添加 Telegram、Slack 等聊天渠道、改触发规则、加外部服务或调整 NanoClaw 行为时触发。

say.text: 把 Telegram 加为输入渠道
say.note: 会先询问接哪个 agent group 和隔离级别

say.text: 给客服分组换用 Claude Opus 模型
say.note: 同步更新 container_configs 配置

say.text: 改触发规则，让这个群不再自动回复
say.note: 更新该群 wiring 的触发规则

howto.what_en: It first asks what you want, then guides you through adding chat channels, changing triggers, connecting external services, or adjusting config, and tells you how to rebuild and restart to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add a chat channel like Telegram or Slack, change trigger rules, connect an external service, or adjust NanoClaw behavior.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel.
say_en.note: It will ask how to wire it up.

say_en.text: Switch the customer-service group to Claude Opus.
Change the trigger rules so this group stops replying.
